children: FGI's revenue fell 11.6% year over year, while its net loss narrowed 42.7%. Lower sanitaryware and shower-system sales drove the revenue decline, partly offset by a 32.8% increase in other revenue; lower income-tax provision helped narrow the net loss.
¹ Reported as “Revenue”. ² Reported as “Net loss attributable to FGI Industries Ltd. shareholders”. ³ Reported as “Diluted”.
: Sanitaryware revenue fell 16.6% and shower-system revenue declined 22.9%; other revenue rose 32.8%.
: Rose 110 basis points to 27.6%, as product mix and cost-control efforts partly offset lower volume, fixed-cost absorption and competitive pricing.
: Other revenue, primarily custom kitchen cabinetry, increased 32.8%, driven mainly by continued volume growth at Covered Bridge.
: New programs secured during the quarter broadened future sales opportunities but had not ramped enough to offset the quarterly decline.
